import Foundation

// CASE swift_tuple_write expect=pass
func w1(_ items: [String], _ op: @escaping (String) async throws -> Void, parse: () -> (Int, Int)) async throws {
    var width = 1
    var retries = 0
    (width, retries) = parse()
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width: width, operation: op)
}

// CASE swift_plus_equals expect=pass
func w2(_ items: [String], _ op: @escaping (String) async throws -> Void, extra: Int) async throws {
    var width = 1
    width += extra
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width: width, operation: op)
}

// CASE swift_guard_let expect=pass
func w3(_ items: [String], _ op: @escaping (String) async throws -> Void, config: [String: Int]) async throws {
    var width = 1
    if let configured = config["width"] {
        width = configured
    }
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width: width, operation: op)
}

// CASE swift_do_catch expect=pass
func w4(_ items: [String], _ op: @escaping (String) async throws -> Void, load: () async throws -> Int) async throws {
    var width = 1
    do {
        width = try await load()
    } catch {}
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width: width, operation: op)
}

// CASE swift_inout expect=pass
func w5(_ items: [String], _ op: @escaping (String) async throws -> Void, tune: (inout Int) -> Void) async throws {
    var width = 1
    tune(&width)
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width: width, operation: op)
}

// CASE swift_end expect=pass
